Emergencies

Недостоверная Приборная Скорость

A condition where the airspeed readings provided by the pitot-static system are incorrect or inconsistent, potentially leading to hazardous flight control inputs.

Quick answer: A condition where the airspeed readings provided by the pitot-static system are incorrect or inconsistent, potentially leading to hazardous flight control inputs.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

A condition where the airspeed readings provided by the pitot-static system are incorrect or inconsistent, potentially leading to hazardous flight control inputs.

Operational example

We are declaring a PAN due to unreliable airspeed indications and switching to pitch and power settings.

Localized term

Недостоверная Приборная Скорость

Localized example

Объявляем PAN из-за недостоверных показаний скорости и переходим на управление по тангажу и тяге.
